exposure: de novo truncating variants in additional sex combs like 3 (ASXL3)
cohort: Four patients admitted to the Children's Hospital Affiliated to Shandong University between June 2022 and January 2024, diagnosed with unexplained intellectual disabilities or developmental delay, were identified with de novo truncation of ASXL3.
finding: De novo truncating variants in ASXL3 were identified in four patients presenting with Bainbridge-Ropers syndrome, contributing to the understanding of ASXL3 mutational and phenotypic spectra, and highlighting subtle distinctions in clinical manifestations among Chinese patients.
cross-section timing: Patient identification occurred between June 2022 and January 2024.
